title: TDD With AI Agents: Design the Tests First, Let the Agent Implement
description: Learn how to use test-driven development (TDD) with AI agents in Python. Design the tests first, then let a coding agent write code that passes them.
summary: When your test suite passes, you know the code matches your tests. However, if an AI agent wrote both, then all you know is that the agent agrees with itself.
takeaways: In Real Python’s Building Python Projects With AI Agents live course, you build a real project with an agent writing every line while you write the specification, judge what comes back, and sharpen your testing judgment.
Other repository-aware agents like GitHub Copilot CLI , Antigravity CLI , and OpenCode can follow the same workflow.
